Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Sharmin Akhter and Murshida Khatun are at the crease. The veteran, Jhulan Goswami will start proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Bangladesh Women have their task cut out as chasing 230 isn't going to be easy on a track that is quite sluggish. India Women have added another spinner in the form of Poonam Yadav for this game and they would be confident of defending this total. Do join us for the chase which begins shortly.

Yastika Bhatia is down for a chat. She says she feels good to contribute, but she wants to do much more. Mentions that she is happy to contribute for her team in whatever situation the team is in. Informs that she likes to anchor the innings. States that the pitch is slow and the bowlers were also bowling slowly which made it a little difficult to score. Concludes by saying that 229 should be enough.

Bangladesh Women pulled things back really well in their favour after having leaked runs at the start of the innings. The spinners kept bowling tight lines and lengths and hardly gave away any freebies. Nahida Akter did pick a couple of crucial wickets but the standout performer was Ritu Moni who grabbed three wickets for just 27 runs, which also included the prized scalp of Mithali Raj who was sent back for a duck. Bangladesh Women would still feel that they gave away 20 runs extra in the end.

After having opted to bat first, India Women got off to a great start as the opening pair of Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma took the attack to the opposition and scored freely. Just when it was looking like India Women would post a mammoth total on the board, things fell apart for them as they lost wickets in quick succession and were put on the back foot. It was Yastika Bhatia who held one end and ensured that India were not bundled out cheaply. Although, she perished just after getting to her half-century, and then it was Sneh Rana and Pooja Vastrakar who batted sensibly and took their side to safer shores.

A decent recovery in the end from India Women, as at one point, they were stuttering at 176/6. The pair of Pooja Vastrakar and Sneh Rana have ensured that they post a very competitive total on the board. Bangladesh Women would be a bit disappointed as they failed to take advantage of the momentum they had gathered in the middle phase of the innings.
Full, around off. Jhulan Goswami lifts it towards long off. The fielder there fumbles to grab the ball cleanly and that allows the batters to take two runs. India Women end at 229/7!
Very full, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar clears her front leg and whips it towards mid on for a single.
Very full, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar shimmies down the track and drives it past cover-point for a couple of runs.
Jhulan Goswami walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jahanara Alam strikes in the final over and Sneh Rana fails to go on till the end! Another soft dismissal. Jahanara Alam pitches it full, wide of off. Sneh Rana walks across and she wanted to paddle-scoop this, but because the ball was wide of off, she opens the face of her bat and ends up chipping it towards short third man. Ritu Moni there, takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ritu Moni b Jahanara Alam

Commentary.Commentary: On a length this time, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar steps down the pitch and slashes it towards deep cover. Single!
Pitches it up, outside off. Sneh Rana advances down the track and drives it past cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Fuller ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar steps down the pitch and hammers it past cover for another boundary. Good over for India Women, 13 runs off it!
Fuller ball, outside off. Sneh Rana walks across and sweeps it past short fine leg. Three taken!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Slower through the air, full, around middle. Sneh Rana dances down the track and lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Tosses it up, very full, on middle. Sneh Rana digs it out.
Fullish delivery, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar advances down the track and knocks it towards long on.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Sneh Rana drags it with the inner half of her bat towards mid on for a single.
Nahida Akter (8-0-29-2) is back on.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sneh Rana drives it towards long off for a single. She retains the strike!
FOUR! Cheeky! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Sneh Rana gets down on her knee and paddles it between the keeper and the fielder at short fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller this time, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar advances down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single.
A low full toss, around middle. Sneh Rana heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, outside this time. Pooja Vastrakar steps down the pitch and drives it towards sweeper cover. Pooja Vastrakar wanted a second there but she was denied by Sneh Rana. Single taken!
Pitched up delivery, around middle. Sneh Rana strokes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Gets hold of it this time! Tad fuller, around off. Pooja Vastrakar once again backs away and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary. 200 up for India Women!
Outside off, shorter ball. Pooja Vastrakar back away and cuts it over the fielder at point. Two taken!
Fraction shorter, outside off. Sneh Rana cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Turning in, short ball, on middle. Sneh Rana taps it towards cover. No run taken!
Tad fuller, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it uppishly towards deep cover for another single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Sneh Rana pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Slower, full, around middle and leg. Sneh Rana whips it past square leg. Three taken!
Full once again, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar drives it past the bowler towards long off for a single.
A full toss, on middle. Sneh Rana pulls it past mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Very full, around off. Pooja Vastrakar steps down the pitch and tries to drive this, but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat onto her pads and rolls towards the off side. Single!
Fraction short, wide of off. Sneh Rana stays in her crease and slashes it past cover-point for a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Sneh Rana taps it towards cover. No run taken!
Jahanara Alam (5-0-29-0) comes back to bowl.
Floated, full and outside off. Pooja Vastrakar gets to the pitch of the ball and tucks it to mid-wicket.
DROPPED! A tough one for the bowler! A loopy ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar skips down a bit and smashes it straight back to the bowler who fails to grab it. Pooja Vastrakar survives.

NOT OUT! Clever from Salma Khatun but Sneh Rana does well to get back in time. On a length, around off. Pooja drags it back to the bowler. Rana at the non-striker's end was backing up a bit too much. Salma collects the ball and pushes it back onto the stumps at her end. They appeal but the replays show that Rana was home before the bails were dislodged.
Is that a run out? The bowler throws the ball back on the stumps at the non-striker's end. But, Sneh Rana has made her ground just in time.
A quicker ball, outside off. Sneh Rana slaps it through the cover region for a run.

TWO LEG BYES! This is a flatter ball, angling down leg. Sneh Rana looks to paddle it but she misses. The ball brushes off her thigh pad and goes towards the fine leg region. The batters collect a couple of leg byes.
Flatter ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar punches it past cover and rotates the strike.

Good running! A length ball, outside off. Sneh Rana looks to push it through the off side but she gets a thick outside edge through the third man region. The batters push hard for the second run and get that easily in the end.
On a length, around off. Sneh Rana keeps it out.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Sneh Rana hangs back to cut hard but she fails to get any blade on it.
A short ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar flat-bats it towards long on and takes a run.
Back of a length, around middle. Sneh Rana tucks it to the leg side for a single. She gets off the mark straightaway!
Sneh Rana walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, dear! Yastika Bhatia tries to get cheeky but ends up throwing away her wicket! Huge blow for India Women as another set batter walks back to the hut. This is a length ball, around off. Bhatia shuffles across and scoops it straight to Nahida Akter at short fine leg who takes a good catch moving to her left. India Women lose their sixth wicket and they are in a spot of bother now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nahida Akter b Ritu Moni

Commentary.Commentary: She finally gets the single and gets to her FIFTY as well! Top innings from her so far but she must bat deep here for her side. On a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia works it to long off for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards cover. Four dots in a row!
This is tossed up, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it to the cover fielder who dives to her right and stops the ball.
On a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia tries to guide it through the third man region but she misses.
Flatter ball, on a length and outside off. Yastika Bhatia taps it towards point. Pooja Vastrakar wanted to sneak in a run but Bhatia sends her back.
Floated, full and around middle. Pooja Vastrakar eases it to long on for a run.
A misfield in the deep and they get the second run easily! Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
A low full toss, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it to long on and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar cuts it to the point fielder.
On a length and outside off. Pooja Vastrakar prods and drives it on the up towards cover.
A full ball, on middle. Yastika Bhatia drills it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it towards cover for one run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar cuts it to deep cover for a run.
A short ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, full and on middle. Pooja Vastrakar tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Fuller in length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Pooja Vastrakar keeps it out.
A short ball, on middle. Yastika Bhatia pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
End of Powerplay 2! Bangladesh Women can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
On a length, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar knocks it uppishly just away from mid on.
Good-length, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it towards cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar cuts it towards deep cover for a brace.
Fuller ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it towards cover.
Fuller, outside offf. Pooja Vastrakar looks to push this but she misses
Shorter ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single. She gets off the mark and she will keep the strike as well.
Pooja Vastrakar walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! And there it is! Nahida Akter manages to get the timely breakthrough. The partnership has finally been broken. This time Richa Ghosh does get an edge. Quicker now, straighter, outside off. Richa Ghosh stays in her crease and once again tries to cut this on the off side, but she manages to get a faint edge back to the keeper. Nigar Sultana holds on to it this time. India Women lose half their side.
Commentary.Howout: c Nigar Sultana b Nahida Akter

Commentary.Commentary: And once again! Richa Ghosh is just getting away with that edge! Outside off, fuller ball. Richa Ghosh backs away, and tries to chop this but she gets beaten.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Richa Ghosh drives it towards cover.
Loopy ball this time, outside off, full in length. Richa Ghosh hangs back and looks to slash this but she fails to get any bat on it.
Fullish delivery, around off. Yastika Bhatia stays in her crease and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Angling in, around off, on a length. Richa Ghosh pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Full again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia knocks it towards long off and takes a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards the fielder at mid off.

The skipper, Nigar Sultana looks in some pain. The physio is out to have a check on her as she seems to have hurt herself in the process. The magic spray seems to have done the trick and we are good to go.

DROPPED! Nigar Sultana has dropped a catch behind the stumps! On a length, width on offer. Richa Ghosh stays in her crease and looks to cut this away, but she manages to get just a faint edge back to the keeper. Nigar Sultana fails to hold on to the catch and she might have hurt her finger in the process. The ball rolls towards third man and the batters take a single.
Tailing back in, around middle, fuller this time. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards long on. Single taken!
Angling in, on middle, on a length. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Ritu Moni (6-2-23-2) is back on.
Much fuller now, outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it towards extra cover.
Wide of off again, short ball. Richa Ghosh cuts and finds the fielder at cover-point this time.
Short again, on middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it to long on for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
Shorter ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards cover.
Tad fuller, outside off. Yastika Bhatia opens the face of her bat and tries to guide this, but she fails to get any bat on it.
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Yastika Bhatia looks to tuck this, but she misses. Wide called!
FOUR! Short, wide of off. Richa Ghosh stays in her crease and slashes this past cover-point for a boundary. Anything wide of off she is putting it away! Lovely batting!
Tad shorter, spinning away, outside off. Richa Ghosh slashes it past point for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up, full again, around off. Richa Ghosh drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Richa Ghosh sweeps it towards the fielder at square leg.
Slower through the air again, full, on middle. Yastika Bhatia once again advances down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single. 150 up for India Women!
Tosses it up, very full, outside off. Yastika Bhatia steps down the pitch, opens the face of her bat, and squeezes it towards third man. Two taken!
Tossed up delivery, around off. Richa Ghosh keeps it out watchfully.
A loopy ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh kneels to sweep but she misses and gets hit on her pad. The impact might have been well outside off this time.

NOT OUT! A direct hit and that could have been curtains for Richa! Flatter ball, on off. Yastika Bhatia taps it to point and sets off for a quick run. The fielder at point throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off. Richa stretches to get home. There is an appeal for run out and the decision has been sent upstairs. The replays show that Richa was inside her crease.
Is that a run out? There is a throw at the keeper's end. The replay shows Richa Ghosh has made her ground before the keeper whips the bails off. NOT OUT is the decision!
Wide! First wide of the innings! This is a wayward ball, well outside off. Yastika Bhatia does not bother playing at that one.
A bit quicker this time, full and outside off. Richa drives it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
This is looped up, well outside off. Richa Ghosh lets it through to the keeper.
Another ball that is short and outside off. Richa slaps it wide of the sweeper cover and comes back for the second run.
A short ball, spinning away from outside off. Richa stays back and cuts it through the cover region for a single.
This is darted on the pads. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Looped up, outside off. Richa cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A loopy ball, on a length, around middle. Richa Ghosh keeps it out solidly.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Tossed up, outside off and turning away late. Richa Ghosh prods to block but the ball spins past her outside edge.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Richa Ghosh looks to cut but she gets a thick outside edge past the short third man fielder for a couple of runs.

DRINKS! After losing four wickets in quick succession, India Women are trying to rebuild here. Both Yastika Bhatia and Richa Ghosh are looking comfortable at the crease for now. Bangladesh Women have used quite a few bowlers to keep India under pressure, but they will need a few wickets to take things under control and not let India get away with a big partnership.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Yastika Bhatia skips down and lofts it over covers for a couple of runs.
This is a flighted delivery, around middle. Richa Ghosh tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Richa Ghosh prods and pushes it to cover.
Shorter in length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and slaps it through the cover region for a run.
On a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards backward point.
Flatter ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia stays back to punch it through covers but it goes off the thick inside edge towards square leg.
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards sweeper cover and the batters take a single.
This is darted on the pads. Bhatia tickles it fine through the fine leg region for a brace.
FOUR! BANG! A rare loose delivery from Bangladesh Women and Yastika Bhatia pounces on it! A half-tracker, outside off. Bhatia rocks back and whacks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A googly, on a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia stays back and punches it back to the bowler.
This is flatter and on middle. Yastika Bhatia nudges it to short fine leg.
Shorter in length, outside off. Richa Ghosh rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Fahima Khatun comes into the attack.
Tosses it up, outside off. Richa Ghosh gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to long on for a single.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, around off. Richa wrists it to mid-wicket.
Floated, full and on off. Richa Ghosh covers the line of the ball and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it wide of sweeper cover and looks for the second run but Richa Ghosh is not interested as she sends her back.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Yastika Bhatia dabs it to point.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia shuffles across and paddles it through fine leg for a brace. The keeper, Nigar Sultana chases it down.
Back of a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single. She retains the strike.
On the pads this time, tad fuller. Richa Ghosh tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A similar shot! Wide of off, on a length. Richa Ghosh chops it past point once again for a boundary.

FOUR! Much-needed boundary for India Women! Shaping away outside off, on a length. Richa Ghosh stays in her crease and slashes it past the diving fielder at backward point. She gets off the mark with that!
Outside off, fuller in length. Richa Ghosh leans to drive but she misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Just a tad short, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it to the point fielder. A maiden over from Rumana Ahmed!
Floated, outside off. Yastika Bhatia prods and dabs it towards point.
Tad short, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though.
On a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover once again.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards cover-point this time.
Fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover.
Outside off, on a length. Richa Ghosh pushes it towards cover.

Two Leg byes! Good-length delivery, darting it on the pads. Richa Ghosh looks to flick but she misses. The ball brushes off her pads and goes towards fine leg. The batters steal two leg byes in return!
Outside off, another length delivery. Richa Ghosh leaves it alone.
On a length, on the pads. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is the last thing India Women wanted at this point. It is their in-form batter, Harmanpreet Kaur who walks back to the hut. Bangladesh Women have their fourth wicket. This was a fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end. Fargana Hoque at mid on, runs to her left, collects the ball, and throws it directly on to the stumps at the non-striker's end. Harmanpreet Kaur is well short of her crease. Huge moment in this game and the Bangladeshi players are thrilled to see the back of Kaur.

Is that a run out? A direct hit at the bowler's end and Harmanpreet Kaur might be in trouble. The decision has been sent upstairs. The replays roll in and it shows that Kaur is well short of her crease. Brilliant piece of fielding from Fargana Hoque!
On a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards cover.
Tad shorter, outside off. Yastika Bhatia defends it towards cover.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it past square leg for a single.
Touch shorter, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur walks down the pitch and knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur stays in her crease and cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Much fuller now, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and paddles it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur advances down the pitch and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Full, outside off. Yastika Bhatia lunges and drives it past cover-point for a brace.
Outside off, fuller ball. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards cover. The fielder there dives to her right and makes a good stop.
Full in length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur presses forward and dabs it towards point for a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards mid on
On a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Very full, wide of off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans forward and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A googly, on a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia dabs it towards point.
Flatter ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it to the off side.
Tosses it up, on middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia gets donw on her knee and sweeps it uppishly over square leg for a brace. 100 comes up for India Women!
Flighted ball, outside off. Kaur kneels and sweeps it to deep square leg without much timing for a run.
Floated, full and outside off. Kaur gets down on her knee to sweep but she misses and gets hit low on her pad.
Rumana sees Kaur dancing down the track so she drags her length back, around middle. Kaur eases it to mid-wicket.
A full ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia digs it out to cover.
Another ball, that is full and well outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
A slower ball, on a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia nudges it around the corner and takes a run.
Lata drags her length back, around middle. Yastika Bhatia defends it onto the deck.
This is full and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur reaches out and drives it to deep cover for one run.
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Lata Mondal comes into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely swept away! This is tossed up, on middle. Kaur kneels and sweeps it through the mid-wicket region and bags a boundary. The fielder in the deep dives to stop the ball but to no avail.
Kaur goes down the track and defends it onto the deck.
Floated, full and around off. Harmanpreet Kaur keeps it out.
This is a flighted delivery, around off. Yastika Bhatia runs it down to long on and hands the strike back to Kaur.
Kaur skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to long on for a run.
A loopy ball, on middle. Yastika Bhatia slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
A slight mix-up but no harm done! Good-length ball, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur taps it to point. Yastika Bhatia wanted a single but is sent back by Kaur in time.
Back of a length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur keeps it out.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it to sweeper cover and settles for a single.
Floated, full and on middle. Yastika Bhatia drags it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! A welcome boundary for India Women! Just a tad short, outside off. Yastika Bhatia slaps it through the point region and bags a boundary.
Aerial but safe! Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia looks to block but the ball hits the splice of her bat and lobs out just wide of the bowler.
Floated, full and around off. Kaur blocks it off the front foot. Just 1 run off it.
This is darted on the pads. Yastika Bhatia prods and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it to cover.
Tosses it up, around off. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out.
Floated, full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it to the cover fielder.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! This is tossed up, down leg. Yastika Bhatia looks to sweep but she misses and gets hit on her pad. Might have pitched outside leg.
Pitched up ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out. A maiden over from Ritu Moni!
Tad shorter now, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it towards point.
Fuller now, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur once again pushes it back to Moni.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it back to the bowler.
Tad shorter now, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it off the back foot towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leaves it alone.
Back of a length , outside off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards cover.
Tad fuller now, around off. Yastika Bhatia defends it out off the front foot.
Another shorter ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Tad shorter, around off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards extra cover.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur eases it towards long off for a single.
Spinning away, shorter ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it towards cover.
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it towards mid on.
Very full, outside off. Yastika Bhatia squeezes it towards backward point for a brace.
On a length now, around middle. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Pitched up delivery again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it past point. The fielder from third man does well to stop the ball. Two taken!
Fullish ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards cover.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Tad shorter, off-break this time, around middle. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out off the back foot.
Fuller, slower through the air, full. Yastika Bhatia defends it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards point.
Outside off, fuller ball. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it to the off side.
Good-length ball, around off. Kaur keeps it out.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, dear! India Women are losing their way after a solid start! Another wicket goes down. Ritu Moni strikes once again and sends back the Indian skipper on her very first ball. Back-to-back wickets for her. This is a soft dismissal. Another length ball, around off. Mithali Raj leans to drive this but the ball goes off the splice of the bat and lobs up straight towards cover. Fahima Khatun takes an easy catch there. Ritu Moni is on a hat-trick!
Commentary.Howout: c Fahima Khatun b Ritu Moni

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! Bangladesh Women are back in this contest! The spinners are doing the trick for Bangladesh Women yet again. After a solid start by India, they have lost both their openers in quick succession and need some stability now. Mithali Raj walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! This is exactly what Bangladesh Women needed. Another set batter gone back to the hut now. Ritu Moni strikes and gets rid of Shafali Verma. A big, big wicket for Bangladesh Women. This one lands on a length, outside off. Shafali Verma steps ahead looks to push this one, but she misses and gets beaten on the outside edge. Nigar Sultana grabs the ball, behind the sticks and whips the bails off. Shafali Verma is way out of her crease and has to walk back. India Women lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: st Nigar Sultana b Ritu Moni

Commentary.Commentary: Another pitched up delivery, around off. Shafali Verma pushes it towards mid off once again.
Fuller ball, around off. Shafali Verma drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Yastika Bhatia walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket against the run of play and it is Nahida Akter that provides Bangladesh a much-needed breakthrough! Mandhana would be absolutely gutted as she could have dispatched this ball wherever she wanted to! This is a short ball, turning in from outside off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and pulls it straight to Fargana Hoque at square leg who takes a good low catch. India Women lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Fargana Hoque b Nahida Akter

Commentary.Commentary: An appeal for LBW but turned down! This is tossed up, outside off and spinning in late. Mandhana kneels to sweep but she misses and gets hit low on her pad.
Full and outside off. Shafali Verma advances down the track and drives it to long off for one run.
Floated, full and around middle. Shafali Verma skips down and works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it to long off and rotates the strike.
Tosses it up, around off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, outside off. Shafali Verma drives it to the extra cover fielder.
A full ball, well outside off. Mandhana drives it to sweeper cover and hands the strike back to Verma.
Full and outside off. Shafali Verma eases it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Pierces the gap to perfection! Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Verma hangs back and cuts it through the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana drills it to long off for a single.
On a length and jagging back in from middle. Smriti Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Just a tad short, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back and punches it to the left of the bowler. Just 2 runs off the over!
On a length and around off. Verma pushes it back to the bowler.
This is flatter and on middle. Verma keeps it out.
Full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, around off. Shafali Verma drives it to long off for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma cuts it to deep cover for one run.

NOT OUT! The bat hit the pad there! Back of a length, outside off. Verma stays back to cut but she misses. There is some noise and that excites the Bangladeshi Women. They appeal but the umpire says no. They opt for a review but the UltraEdge shows that the bat hit the pad and the ball was away from the bat. Bangladesh Women lose a review.
Review! Bangladesh Women have reviewed a caught behind decision against Shafali Verma. No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Shafali Verma survives.
A length ball, outside off. Verma prods and works it to the extra cover fielder.
Full and way outside off. Verma drives it to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Streaky! This is full and outside off. Verma looks to drive on the up but she gets a thick outside edge which goes past the short third man fielder and into the fence.
Short of a length, just outside off. Verma hangs back and taps it to short third man.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack.
Just a tad short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana stays back and taps it to towards short third man. A dot to end the over!
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma works it to long on and rotates the strike.
A bit quicker, on a length, around middle. Smriti Mandhana skips down, waits for the ball to turn and then guides it to long on for a run.
Full and outside off. Shafali Verma drives it down to long off and takes a single.
Mandhana comes down the track and drills it to long off for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover.
End of Powerplay 1! Bangladesh Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR! Make that three boundaries in the over! Looks like nothing can stop Shafali Verma at the moment! Outside off, on a length. Shafali Verma stays in her crease and slashes it past point for a boundary. That brings the 50 for India Women! An excellent Powerplay for India Women.
FOUR! This is the Shafali Verma we all know! Another full ball, around middle. Shafali Verma heaves it over mid-wicket for another cracking boundary.
Wide of off, on a length. Shafali Verma cuts it towards backward point.
FOUR! Shafali Verma means business! An overpitched delivery, around middle. Shafali Verma tonks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full again, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards mid off and takes a single.
Full, wide of off. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Full, around off. Shafali Verma defends it out. 14 runs off Nahida Akter's first over!

TWO BYES! Good comeback by Nahida Akter! Fuller ball, this one comes in with the angle, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back and looks to chop this but she gets beaten on as the ball sneaks past her inside edge. The keeper fails to grab it as well. Two byes taken!
FOUR! Shafali Verma is on the charge! Another tossed up ball, full, around middle. Shafali Verma gets low and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Shafali Verma takes the aerial route again! Fuller again, around middle. Shafali Verma lifts it over the bowler's head. The ball won't race away towards the boundary but the batters take a couple of runs!
SIX! BOOM! Slower through the air now, fuller, around middle. Shafali Verma smashes it over long on for a biggie. First six of the innings!
Beaten! Nahida Akter begins with a quicker one, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back and looks to cut this away but she misses as the ball skids off the surface.
Nahida Akter comes to bowl now. She replaces Salma Khatun.
Very full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it towards the fielder at backward point.
Pitches it up, around middle. Shafali Verma works it away towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Jahanara Alam goes over the wicket, shaping away outside off, on a length. Shafali Verma blocks it towards point.
Back of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it off the back foot towards cover and takes a single.
Much fuller now, outside off, jagging in again. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive but the ball goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg.
Tailing back in, around middle, on a length. Smriti Mandhana defends it out.
Fuller, spinning in, around off. Shafali Verma hangs back and defends it towards the off side.
Salma Khatun goes over the wicket, serves a tad shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Shafali Verma pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, outside off, on a fuller length. Smriti Mandhana leans and taps it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out watchfully.
Flatter, around middle. Smriti Mandhana defends it out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A loopy ball, full, spinning away. Smriti Mandhana dances down the track and goes inside-out over covers for a boundary.
Much fuller on this occasion, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards mid off and takes a single. She retains the strike!
Angling in, on a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it off the back foot to the fielder at mid off.
Nipping back in, outside off, on a length. Smriti Mandhana taps it towards backward point.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back and guides it towards third man for a single.
Touch fuller and wide of off. Shafali Verma stays in her crease and cuts it towards the fielder at point.
A fuller ball, shaping away, around off. Shafali Verma defends it towards cover.
An arm ball that goes on with the angle from off. Smriti Mandhana prods to defend but it goes off the thick inside edge towards square leg. A maiden over from Salma Khatun!
This is a quicker ball, full and on off. Smriti Mandhana works it towards cover. Not in the gap though!
Flatter and quicker, around off. Smriti Mandhana keeps it out.
On a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards the cover fielder where the fielder fumbles. Mandhana calls for a run at first but sends back Verma in the end.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it towards cover.
Tosses it up, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to the left of the bowler. Salma Khatun moves there and stops it.
Cut hard but for no run! Shorter in length, outside off. Verma rides the bounce nicely and cuts hard but straight to the point fielder.
Back of a length, just outside off. Verma stands tall and punches it to the cover-point fielder.
Short of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana stays back and steers it to third man for a run.
Pitches it up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana squeezes it out towards cover.
A length ball, around the fourth stump channel. Smriti Mandhana keeps it out.
Back of a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards the backward point fielder who fumbles and the batters collect a couple of runs.
Uppish but safe! On a length, around off. Mandhana stays back and slaps it through the cover region for a single. Another tidy over from Salma Khatun, just 2 runs off it!
Flatter and quicker, just outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and pushes it to the cover fielder.
A bit quicker, on a length, around off. Mandhana goes back in her crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, full and around off. Smriti Mandhana prods and keeps it out.
Floated, on middle. Verma eases it to long on for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Verma punches it to cover.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Alam drags her length back, around middle. Mandhana rocks back and swivel-pulls it through the backward square leg region for another boundary.
FOUR! Lovely timing and even better placement from Mandhana! This is full and outside off. Mandhana prods and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Alam goes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
That stayed a tad low! Good-length ball, angling away across the batter. Smriti Mandhana stays back to punch it through cover but she misses.
Full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to the cover fielder.
Edged but safe! Fuller in length, outside off. Shafali Verma looks to drive but the ball shapes away late and it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run. Verma is off the mark!
Jahanara Alam will bowl from the other end.
Slower through the air, on a length, around off and spinning away late. Smriti Mandhana goes back in her crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
This is tossed up, around off. Smriti Mandhana gets forward and blocks it.
A bit quicker, on a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and defends it to the off side.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Another ball, flatter and going on with the angle from off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and slaps it through the cover region for a couple of runs. India Women are up and running!
Salma starts with a flatter ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana stays back and punches it to the cover fielder.

The sun is out at Seddon Park and we are all set for action! The players stride out to the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will open the batting for India Women. Salma Khatun will begin with the ball. Here we go...
It is time for the national anthems! The match officials and the two sides have lined up for their respective national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's first, followed by India's.

PITCH REPORT - Sanjay Manjrekar is near the pitch along with WV Raman. The latter says that the pitch looks dry and there will be a lot of assistance for the spinners. Tells that it is going to be an exciting contest between the spinners and the batters.

Nigar Sultana, the skipper of Bangladesh Women, says that they would have batted first, but the bowlers have done well in the tournament and she is happy to bowl first. Mentions that they want to restrict India to a good total. Informs that they have two changes.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India Women, says that they will bat first. Adds that the wicket looks very dry and there was a lot of turn on this wicket in the last game. Tells that they need to field well and back the bowlers. Mentions that their batters need to bat sensibly as well.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Sharmin Akhter, Murshida Khatun (In for Shamima Sultana), Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C/WK), Rumana Ahmed, Ritu Moni, Lata Mondal (In for Fariha Trisna), Salma Khatun, Fahima Khatun, Nahida Akter, Jahanara Alam.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Poonam Yadav (In for Meghna Singh), Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Bangladesh Women are languishing at the bottom half of the table but they have shown great fighting spirit and will continue to do so. We have seen how dangerous their bowlers can be but it’s time for their batters to display their true potential. A win for them today will make the race for the semi-final more intense. Who will come out on top in this mouth-watering contest? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

India Women have lost back-to-back games and now they find themselves in a must-win situation. They will need to turn things around and get over the line. Their batters will have to step up once again. Although it will not be easy since Bangladesh have a quality spin attack.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It’s time for an important clash in the Women’s World Cup 2022. It’s India Women taking on Bangladesh Women at Seddon Park Hamilton in match number 22 of this exciting tournament. Both sides are coming into this game after suffering a loss in their previous game and they will want to put their best foot forward and come out on top to keep themselves ahead in the semi-final race. We witnessed spinners play a crucial role in yesterday’s game on this same ground, and once again they will play a key role. There is also rain predicted, but let’s hope the weather remains clear and we get a full game today!
... MATCH DAY ...
